title: Decompression landmarks
view: Adult male supine, from directly above, head at the top, the patient's right on the image left; the rib cage drawn over the chest.
teachingPoint: Preferred: the 4th or 5th intercostal space at the anterior axillary line; alternate: the 2nd intercostal space at the midclavicular line.
claims: Male torso from above, patient's right on the image left (house laterality; the record says choose the side clinically).
Translucent bones: clavicles, sternum, ribs 1-7 and costal cartilages drawn over the chest (owner, 2026-10-02), from the approved bone layout narrowed 12%.
Teal at the AAL: the 4th and 5th intercostal spaces (record, preferred site).
Teal at the MCL: the 2nd intercostal space, below the 2nd rib whose cartilage meets the sternal angle (record, alternate site).
Nipple at the 4th intercostal space on the MCL (standard male anatomy).
Labels: Clavicle, 2nd ICS, MCL, 4th–5th ICS, AAL, Midclavicular line, Anterior axillary line.
